# ---- CSV 入出力 --------------------------------------------------------
@bp.post("/import_csv")
def import_csv():
    """
    CSV インポート
    - 受領: form-data の file=.csv
    - 受理ヘッダ例:
      name,brand,purchase_price,selling_price,transaction_fee,shipping_cost,customs_duty,procurement_fee,supplier_url,image_url,stock_status
    """
    file = request.files.get("file")
    if not file:
        flash("CSV ファイルが選択されていません。", "error")
        return redirect(url_for("main.manage_products"))

    try:
        data = file.read().decode("utf-8-sig")
        reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(data))

        count = 0
        for row in reader:
            # 必須チェック
            if not row.get("name"):
                continue
            if row.get("purchase_price") in (None, "") or row.get("selling_price") in (None, ""):
                continue

            p = Product(
                name=row.get("name"),
                brand=row.get("brand"),
                purchase_price=float(row.get("purchase_price", 0) or 0),
                selling_price=float(row.get("selling_price", 0) or 0),
                transaction_fee=float(row.get("transaction_fee", 0) or 0),
                shipping_cost=float(row.get("shipping_cost", 0) or 0),
                customs_duty=float(row.get("customs_duty", 0) or 0),
                procurement_fee=float(row.get("procurement_fee", 0) or 0),
                supplier_url=row.get("supplier_url"),
                image_url=row.get("image_url"),
                stock_status=str(row.get("stock_status", "")).strip() in ("1", "true", "True", "yes", "on"),
            )
            db.session.add(p)
            count += 1

        db.session.commit()
        flash(f"CSV を {count} 件取り込みました。", "success")
    except Exception as e:
        db.session.rollback()
        flash(f"CSV 取り込みに失敗しました: {e}", "error")

    return redirect(url_for("main.manage_products"))

@bp.get("/export_csv")
def export_csv():
    """
    CSV エクスポート
    - 出力ヘッダはインポートと互換
    """
    products: List[Product] = Product.query.order_by(Product.id.asc()).all()
    headers = [
        "id",
        "name",
        "brand",
        "purchase_price",
        "selling_price",
        "transaction_fee",
        "shipping_cost",
        "customs_duty",
        "procurement_fee",
        "supplier_url",
        "image_url",
        "stock_status",
        "created_at",
        "updated_at",
    ]

    buf = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.DictWriter(buf, fieldnames=headers)
    writer.writeheader()

    for p in products:
        writer.writerow({
            "id": p.id,
            "name": p.name,
            "brand": p.brand,
            "purchase_price": p.purchase_price,
            "selling_price": p.selling_price,
            "transaction_fee": p.transaction_fee,
            "shipping_cost": p.shipping_cost,
            "customs_duty": p.customs_duty,
            "procurement_fee": p.procurement_fee,
            "supplier_url": p.supplier_url,
            "image_url": p.image_url,
            "stock_status": int(bool(p.stock_status)),
            "created_at": (p.created_at.isoformat(sep=" ", timespec="seconds") if p.created_at else ""),
            "updated_at": (p.updated_at.isoformat(sep=" ", timespec="seconds") if p.updated_at else ""),
        })

    resp = make_response(buf.getvalue())
    resp.headers["Content-Type"] = "text/csv; charset=utf-8"
    resp.headers["Content-Disposition"] = "attachment; filename=products_export.csv"
    return resp

# ---- API: 倉庫一覧（Buyandship） ---------------------------------------
try:
    from .utils.shipping_agent import ShippingAgent  # 依存が無い環境でもファイルは存在
    _shipping_agent_import_ok = True
except Exception:
    ShippingAgent = None  # type: ignore
    _shipping_agent_import_ok = False

@bp.get("/api/warehouses")
def api_warehouses():
    """
    GET /api/warehouses?country=HK
    - 成功: JSON (list of warehouses)
    - エラー:
        400: country 未指定
        503: ShippingAgent 未利用（Playwright 未導入など）
        500: その他例外
    """
    country = (request.args.get("country") or "").strip().upper()
    if not country:
        return jsonify({"error": "country is required (e.g. HK, TW)"}), 400

    if not _shipping_agent_import_ok or ShippingAgent is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "ShippingAgent is unavailable on this environment."}), 503

    try:
        agent = ShippingAgent()  # 認証は .env の BUYANDSHIP_EMAIL/PASSWORD を参照
        warehouses = agent.get_warehouses_by_country(country)
        return jsonify({"country": country, "warehouses": warehouses})
    except Exception as e:
        # 依存（playwright など）未導入や認証失敗時にここへ
        return jsonify({"error": f"failed to fetch warehouses: {e}"}), 500

@bp.route("/products/add", methods=["GET", "POST"])
def add_product():
    form = ProductForm() if ProductForm else None
    if request.method == "POST":
        if not (Product and form):
            raise BadRequest("Product model or ProductForm not available.")
        if form.validate_on_submit():
            try:
                p = Product(name=form.name.data)
                db.session.add(p)
                db.session.commit()
                flash("Product created.", "success")
                return redirect(url_for("main.product_list"))
            except SQLAlchemyError as e:
                current_app.logger.exception("DB error on create: %s", e)
                db.session.rollback()
                flash("DB error.", "error")
        else:
            flash("Validation error.", "error")
    return render_template_string(_T_PRODUCT_FORM, title="Add Product", form=form)


@bp.route("/products/<int:product_id>/edit", methods=["GET", "POST"])
def edit_product(product_id: int):
    if Product is None:
        raise BadRequest("Product model not available.")
    p = Product.query.get_or_404(product_id)
    form = ProductForm(obj=p) if ProductForm else None
    if request.method == "POST":
        if not form:
            raise BadRequest("ProductForm not available.")
        if form.validate_on_submit():
            try:
                p.name = form.name.data
                db.session.commit()
                flash("Product updated.", "success")
                return redirect(url_for("main.product_detail", product_id=p.id))
            except SQLAlchemyError as e:
                current_app.logger.exception("DB error on update: %s", e)
                db.session.rollback()
                flash("DB error.", "error")
        else:
            flash("Validation error.", "error")
    return render_template_string(_T_PRODUCT_FORM, title=f"Edit Product #{p.id}", form=form)

@bp.route("/tools/bg-remove", methods=["GET", "POST"])
def tools_bg_remove():
    result = None
    if request.method == "POST":
        image_url = request.form.get("image_url", "").strip()
        if not image_url:
            flash("image_url is required.", "error")
        else:
            if remove_background_from_url:
                try:
                    result = remove_background_from_url(image_url)
                except Exception as e:
                    current_app.logger.exception("Background remover error: %s", e)
                    flash("Background remover error.", "error")
            else:
                # ダミー応答
                result = {"status": "skipped", "reason": "ai_background_remover.py not available"}
    return render_template_string(
        _T_BG_REMOVE, title="Background Removal", result=result, remover=bool(remove_background_from_url)
    )


# ------------------------------
# Tools: クローラ実行（デモ）
# ------------------------------
@bp.route("/tools/crawler", methods=["GET", "POST"])
def tools_crawler():
    result = None
    if request.method == "POST":
        url = request.form.get("url", "").strip()
        master_image_url = (request.form.get("master_image_url") or "").strip()
        if not url:
            flash("url is required.", "error")
        else:
            if CrawlerService:
                try:
                    crawler = CrawlerService()
                    try:
                        # master_image_url が空でも動く実装に寄り添う
                        result = crawler.get_product_info(url, master_image_url)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                    finally:
                        crawler.quit()
                except Exception as e:
                    current_app.logger.exception("Crawler error: %s", e)
                    result = {"error": str(e)}
            else:
                result = {"status": "skipped", "reason": "ai_image_crawler.py not available"}
    return render_template_string(
        _T_CRAWLER, title="Crawler", result=result, crawler=bool(CrawlerService)
    )

# ====================== END OF: app\routes_backup.py ======================

# ファイル名: browser_use_agent.py

# Rev: 2.1 (2025-09-09 14:42 JST)

# 機能概要:

# - v2.1での主な変更点:

#   - 認証状態の永続化: 手動ログイン情報を保存し、再利用する機能を搭載。
#   - UI検索フローへの統一: BOT検知を回避するため、常に人間的な導線を辿るように変更。
#   - CLIの刷新: `--setup-login`により、初回ログイン設定と通常実行を明確に分離。

# - Python 3.10以上
# - Playwright (`pip install playwright`, `playwright install chromium`)
#
# --- 使用方法 (コマンドプロンプト or PowerShell) ---
#
# 1) 初回: ログインセットアップ (ヘッドフルでサイトを開き、手動でログインする)
#    # 方法A: storageStateを state_ssense.json に保存
#    python -m app.agents.browser_use_agent --site SSENSE --setup-login --headful
#
#    # 方法B: 永続プロファイルを利用 (指定ディレクトリにログイン情報が保存される)
#    python -m app.agents.browser_use_agent --site SSENSE --setup-login --headful --user-data-dir instance/pw_profile/ssense
#
# 2) 本番実行: 保存した認証情報を利用して、ヘッドレスで情報を取得
#    # 方法A: state_ssense.json を読み込んで実行
#    python -m app.agents.browser_use_agent "Givenchy bags" --site SSENSE
#
#    # 方法B: 永続プロファイルを利用して実行
#    python -m app.agents.browser_use_agent "Givenchy bags" --site SSENSE --user-data-dir instance/pw_profile/ssense

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from urllib.parse import quote_plus
from typing import Optional

from playwright.sync_api import (
    sync_playwright,
    TimeoutError as PWTimeout,
    Page,
    Browser,
    BrowserContext,
)

# ===== サイト別設定 ==========================================================
@dataclass
class SiteSelectors:
    """サイト固有のURLとCSS/Roleロケータ群"""
    home_url: str
    first_link: str
    pdp_title: str
    pdp_price: str

SITES_CONFIG: dict[str, SiteSelectors] = {
    "SSENSE": SiteSelectors(
        home_url="https://www.ssense.com/ja-jp",
        first_link="a[href*='/product/']",
        pdp_title="#pdpProductNameText, [data-test='pdpProductNameText'], h1",
        pdp_price="[data-test='pdpRegularPriceText'], .product-price-mobile__price, .product-price__sale",
    ),
}

# ===== パス/ユーティリティ ====================================================
APP_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
INSTANCE_DIR = APP_ROOT / "instance"
SS_DIR = INSTANCE_DIR / "screenshots"
AUTH_DIR = INSTANCE_DIR / "auth"
SS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
AUTH_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def ss_path(site: str, context: str) -> Path:
    ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    return SS_DIR / f"failure_{site}_{context}_{ts}.png"

def state_path(site: str) -> Path:
    return AUTH_DIR / f"state_{site.lower()}.json"

# ===== コンテキスト強化・ポップアップ対応 =====================================
def harden_context(browser: Browser, *, storage_state: Optional[str] = None) -> BrowserContext:
    """
    指紋整合（UA/言語/タイムゾーン）と webdriver 無効化を行ったコンテキストを生成
    - storage_state を指定した場合はサインイン状態を再利用
    """
    state_file = storage_state if storage_state and Path(storage_state).exists() else None

    ctx = browser.new_context(
        user_agent=("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                    "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"),
        locale="ja-JP",
        timezone_id="Asia/Tokyo",
        viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900},
        extra_http_headers={"Accept-Language": "ja-JP,ja;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7"},
        storage_state=state_file,
    )
    ctx.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'webdriver', { get: () => undefined });")
    return ctx

def accept_popups(page: Page) -> None:
    """OneTrustなどの同意バナーを可能なら先に閉じる"""
    for css in [
        "button#onetrust-accept-btn-handler",
        "button:has-text('Accept All')",
        "button:has-text('同意')",
        "button:has-text('同意する')",
    ]:
        try:
            page.locator(css).first.click(timeout=1500)
            print("Accepted cookie banner.")
            break
        except Exception:
            pass

# ===== UI検索フロー（人間導線に統一） =========================================
def search_via_ui(page: Page, site_cfg: SiteSelectors, query: str, timeout_ms: int):
    """
    ホーム→検索オーバーレイ→入力→Enter→/search?q= 到達の順に実行（直行検索は行わない）
    """
    # 0) ホームへ
    print(f"Navigating to home: {site_cfg.home_url}")
    page.goto(site_cfg.home_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
    accept_popups(page)

    # 1) 検索オーバーレイを開く
    print("Opening search overlay...")
    search_open_selectors = [
        "i.fa-ssense-magnifier", "a[data-test='mobileNavigationSearchLink']",
        "a.mobile-header-search", "button[aria-label='Open Search']"
    ]
    opened = False
    for css in search_open_selectors:
        try:
            btn = page.locator(css).first
            btn.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
            btn.click()
            opened = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue
    if not opened:
        raise PWTimeout("Failed to open search overlay with any known selector.")

    # 2) 検索フィールドに入力
    print(f"Typing query: '{query}'")
    filled = False
    search_input_selectors = [
        "form[role='search'] input[type='search']", "form[role='search'] input#search-form-input",
        "#search-form-input", "input[aria-label='Search']"
    ]
    for css in search_input_selectors:
        try:
            inp = page.locator(css).first
            inp.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
            inp.fill(query)
            filled = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue
    if not filled:
        raise PWTimeout("Could not find and fill the search input.")

    # 3) 送信→検索結果ページ(PLP)へ
    print("Submitting search...")
    page.keyboard.press("Enter")
    page.wait_for_url("**/search?q=*", timeout=timeout_ms)
    page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
    print("Search results page loaded.")

# ===== エージェント実行フロー =================================================
def run_flow(query: str, site: str, headless: bool,
             user_data_dir: Optional[str],
             load_state_file: Optional[str]) -> dict:
    """
    認証状態を再利用（storageState or 永続プロファイル）しつつUI検索→PDP抽出
    """
    if site not in SITES_CONFIG:
        return {"ok": False, "kind": "CONFIG_ERROR", "message": f"Site '{site}' is not configured."}

    cfg = SITES_CONFIG[site]
    timeout_sec = 45
    timeout_ms = timeout_sec * 1000

    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser = None
        context = None
        try:
            if user_data_dir:
                # 永続コンテキスト方式
                udir = Path(user_data_dir)
                udir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                print(f"Launching with persistent context: {udir}")
                context = pw.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
                    udir,
                    headless=headless,
                    args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled"],
                    locale="ja-JP", timezone_id="Asia/Tokyo",
                    user_agent=("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                                "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"),
                )
            else:
                # storageState方式
                print(f"Launching with storage state: {load_state_file}")
                browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=headless, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled"])
                context = harden_context(browser, storage_state=load_state_file)

            page = context.new_page()
            page.set_default_timeout(timeout_ms)
            page.set_default_navigation_timeout(timeout_ms)

            # UI検索フローを実行
            search_via_ui(page, cfg, query, timeout_ms)

            # PLP→最初のPDPへ
            print("Clicking first product link...")
            link = page.locator(cfg.first_link).first
            link.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout_ms)
            link.click()
            page.wait_for_url("**/product/*", timeout=timeout_ms)
            page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            print("Product detail page (PDP) loaded.")

            # PDP抽出
            print("Extracting data from PDP...")
            price_loc = page.locator(cfg.pdp_price).first
            price_loc.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout_ms)
            title_loc = page.locator(cfg.pdp_title).first
            title_loc.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout_ms)

            out = {
                "site": site, "query": query, "pdp_url": page.url,
                "title": title_loc.inner_text().strip(),
                "price": price_loc.inner_text().strip(),
                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            }
            return {"ok": True, "kind": "SUCCESS", "data": out}

        except PWTimeout as e:
            p = ss_path(site, "timeout")
            try:
                if context and context.pages: context.pages[-1].screenshot(path=p)
            except Exception: p = None
            return {"ok": False, "kind": "TIMEOUT", "message": str(e), "screenshot": str(p) if p else None}
        except Exception as e:
            p = ss_path(site, "agent_error")
            try:
                if context and context.pages: context.pages[-1].screenshot(path=p)
            except Exception: p = None
            return {"ok": False, "kind": "ERROR", "message": str(e), "screenshot": str(p) if p else None}
        finally:
            try:
                if context: context.close()
                if browser and not user_data_dir: browser.close()
            except Exception: pass

# ===== ログインセットアップ ===================================================
def setup_login(site: str, user_data_dir: Optional[str]) -> int:
    """ヘッドフルでホームを開き、手動ログイン後にEnterで認証情報を保存"""
    if site not in SITES_CONFIG:
        print(f"[SETUP] Error: Unknown site '{site}'")
        return 1

    cfg = SITES_CONFIG[site]
    spath = state_path(site)

    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        if user_data_dir:
            # 永続プロファイルモード
            udir = Path(user_data_dir)
            udir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            ctx = pw.chromium.launch_persistent_context(udir, headless=False, locale="ja-JP")
            page = ctx.new_page()
            page.goto(cfg.home_url)
            print(f"\n[SETUP] 永続プロファイルで起動しました: {udir}")
            print("ブラウザで手動ログイン後、こちらの端末でEnterを押してください…")
            input()
            print("[SETUP] ログイン状態はプロファイルに保存されました。")
            ctx.close()
            return 0

        # storageState保存モード
        browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless=False)
        ctx = harden_context(browser)
        page = ctx.new_page()
        page.goto(cfg.home_url)
        print(f"\n[SETUP] storageState保存モードで起動しました。")
        print("ブラウザで手動ログイン後、この端末でEnterを押すと認証情報を保存します…")
        input()
        ctx.storage_state(path=str(spath))
        print(f"[SETUP] 認証情報を保存しました: {spath}")
        ctx.close()
        browser.close()
        return 0

# ===== CLI ===================================================================
def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Browser Agent (v2.0: Auth Reuse + UI Search Fixed)",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawTextHelpFormatter
    )
    parser.add_argument("query", nargs="?", default="", help="Search query (e.g., 'Givenchy bags')")
    parser.add_argument("--site", required=True, choices=list(SITES_CONFIG.keys()), help="Target site name")
    parser.add_argument("--headful", action="store_true", help="Run in headful mode (visible browser)")
    parser.add_argument("--setup-login", action="store_true", help="Run interactive login setup mode")
    parser.add_argument("--user-data-dir", help="Use persistent context with a specified user data directory")
    parser.add_argument("--state-file", help=f"Custom storageState JSON path (default: {AUTH_DIR}/state_<site>.json)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    sfile = args.state_file or str(state_path(args.site))

    if args.setup_login:
        code = setup_login(args.site, user_data_dir=args.user_data_dir)
        raise SystemExit(code)

    if not args.query:
        parser.error("The 'query' argument is required unless --setup-login is specified.")

    res = run_flow(
        query=args.query,
        site=args.site,
        headless=not args.headful,
        user_data_dir=args.user_data_dir,
        load_state_file=sfile,
    )
    print("\n--- Agent Result ---")
    print(json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ==================== START OF: app\agents\persistence_agent.py ====================
# -- coding: utf-8 --
# ======================================================================
# File: app/agents/persistence_agent.py
# Registry: app/agents/persistence_agent.py
# Rev: 1.1 (2025-09-10 13:09 JST)
#
# 目的:
# - 収集データの永続化専任エージェント
# - CSV と DB(Flask/SQLAlchemy) を Strategy で切替
# - DB が有効な場合は ProductPriceHistory への append と EMA7/28/180/365 の更新
#
# 使用ソフト/前提:
# - Python 3.10+
# - Flask アプリ(app, db, ProductPriceHistory が import 可なら DB 使用)
# - DB 未設定時は CSV のみ(output/price_history_*.csv, research_*.{json,csv})
#
# 使い方（例）:
# - from app.agents.persistence_agent import PersistenceAgent
# - pa = PersistenceAgent(use_db=True)
# - pa.ingest_buyma_history(rows) # rows: List[BuymaProduct]
# - pa.snapshot_full_results(final_rows) # rows: List[FinalResult]
#
# 運用メモ:
# - Windows タスクスケジューラ等で日次 --price-history を実行し、CSV/DBへ蓄積
# - DB が落ちた場合でも CSV には保存されるフェイルソフト設計
# ======================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import logging
import re
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Any, TypedDict, Protocol, runtime_checkable

# --- DB (optional) ---
try:
    from app import db
    from app.models import Product, ProductPriceHistory
    FLASK_AVAILABLE = True
except (ImportError, ModuleNotFoundError):
    logging.warning("[PersistenceAgent] Could not import 'app' module/models. DB features will be disabled.")
    db = None
    Product = None
    ProductPriceHistory = None
    FLASK_AVAILABLE = False

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s")

# --- Type Definitions (Orchestratorと共通) ---
class BuymaProduct(TypedDict, total=False):
    captured_at: str
    brand: str
    name: str
    buyma_url: str
    buyma_price: int
    buyma_list_price: Optional[int]
    buyma_discount_pct: Optional[float]
    buyma_sale_until: Optional[str]

class FinalResult(BuymaProduct, total=False):
    supplier_name: str
    supplier_price: float
    supplier_currency: str
    supplier_url: str
    profit: float
    profit_rate: float

# --- Sink Protocol (永続化戦略のインターフェース) ---
@runtime_checkable
class PersistenceSink(Protocol):
    def save_buyma_history(self, rows: List[BuymaProduct]) -> int: ...
    def save_full_results(self, rows: List[FinalResult]) -> int: ...

# --- Sinks (具体的な永続化戦略) ---
class CsvSink:
    """CSV保存戦略クラス"""
    def __init__(self, out_dir: Path = Path("output")) -> None:
        self.out_dir = out_dir
        self.out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    def _get_sanitized_brand(self, rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], default: str = "UNKNOWN") -> str:
        brand = default
        if rows:
            brand = rows[0].get("brand", default) or default
        return re.sub(r'[\\/*?:"<>|]', "", brand)

    def save_buyma_history(self, rows: List[BuymaProduct]) -> int:
        if not rows: return 0
        brand = self._get_sanitized_brand(rows)
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
        history_file = self.out_dir / f"price_history_{brand}_{ts}.csv"
        file_exists = history_file.exists()
        keys = ["captured_at", "brand", "name", "buyma_url", "buyma_price", "buyma_list_price", "buyma_discount_pct", "buyma_sale_until"]

        try:
            with open(history_file, "a", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=keys, extrasaction="ignore")
                if not file_exists:
                    writer.writeheader()
                writer.writerows(rows)
            logging.info(f"[CSV] Saved {len(rows)} price records to {history_file}")
            return len(rows)
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"[CSV] Failed to save history: {e}")
            return 0

    def save_full_results(self, rows: List[FinalResult]) -> int:
        if not rows: return 0
        brand = self._get_sanitized_brand(rows)
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        json_path = self.out_dir / f"research_{brand}_{ts}.json"
        csv_path = self.out_dir / f"research_{brand}_{ts}.csv"

        try:
            json_path.write_text(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            keys = sorted({k for item in rows for k in item.keys()})
            with open(csv_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=keys)
                writer.writeheader()
                writer.writerows(rows)
            logging.info(f"[CSV] Results dumped to {json_path} and {csv_path}")
            return len(rows)
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"[CSV] Failed to save full results: {e}")
            return 0


class DbSink:
    """DB保存戦略クラス"""
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        if not (FLASK_AVAILABLE and db and ProductPriceHistory):
            raise RuntimeError("DB sink requires Flask app/models to be loaded.")
        self._touched_urls: set[str] = set()

    @staticmethod
    def _ema(series: List[float], period: int) -> Optional[float]:
        if not series: return None
        alpha = 2 / (period + 1)
        ema_val = series[0]
        for v in series[1:]:
            ema_val = alpha * v + (1 - alpha) * ema_val
        return float(round(ema_val, 2))

    def _recalc_moving_averages_db(self, url: str) -> None:
        try:
            rows = ProductPriceHistory.query.filter_by(url=url).order_by(ProductPriceHistory.captured_at.asc()).all()
            if not rows: return
            prices = [float(r.price) for r in rows if r.price is not None]
            if not prices: return

            emas = {
                "ema7": self._ema(prices[-7:], 7), "ema28": self._ema(prices[-28:], 28),
                "ema180": self._ema(prices[-180:], 180), "ema365": self._ema(prices[-365:], 365),
            }
            latest_record = rows[-1]
            for k, v in emas.items():
                if hasattr(latest_record, k) and v is not None:
                    setattr(latest_record, k, v)
            db.session.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"[DB] EMA recompute failed for {url}: {e}")
            db.session.rollback()

    def save_buyma_history(self, rows: List[BuymaProduct]) -> int:
        if not rows: return 0
        saved = 0
        try:
            for r in rows:
                captured_at_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(r["captured_at"]) if r.get("captured_at") else datetime.utcnow()
                rec = ProductPriceHistory(
                    brand=r.get("brand"), name=r.get("name"), url=r.get("buyma_url"),
                    price=r.get("buyma_price"), list_price=r.get("buyma_list_price"),
                    discount_pct=r.get("buyma_discount_pct"), sale_until=r.get("buyma_sale_until"),
                    captured_at=captured_at_dt,
                )
                db.session.add(rec)
                if r.get("buyma_url"):
                    self._touched_urls.add(r["buyma_url"])
            db.session.commit()
            saved = len(rows)
            logging.info(f"[DB] inserted {saved} rows into ProductPriceHistory")
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"[DB] transaction failed: {e}")
            db.session.rollback()

        for url in list(self._touched_urls):
            self._recalc_moving_averages_db(url)
        self._touched_urls.clear()
        return saved

    def save_full_results(self, rows: List[FinalResult]) -> int:
        logging.info("[DB] save_full_results is not implemented (no-op).")
        return 0

#--- PersistenceAgent 本体 ---
class PersistenceAgent:
    """
    - CSV は常に保存（バックアップ/可搬性）
    - DB が利用可能なときのみ DB にも保存し、EMA を更新
    """
    def __init__(self, use_db: bool = False) -> None:
        self.csv_sink = CsvSink()
        self.db_sink: Optional[DbSink] = None
        if use_db:
            try:
                self.db_sink = DbSink()
                logging.info("[PersistenceAgent] Initialized with DB+CSV sinks.")
            except Exception as e:
                logging.warning(f"[PersistenceAgent] DbSink init failed, falling back to CSV only. reason={e}")
        else:
            logging.info("[PersistenceAgent] Initialized with CSV-only sink.")

    def ingest_buyma_history(self, rows: List[BuymaProduct]) -> None:
        """BUYMAの価格履歴（listページ→PDP抽出合成済み）を保存"""
        self.csv_sink.save_buyma_history(rows)
        if self.db_sink:
            self.db_sink.save_buyma_history(rows)

    def snapshot_full_results(self, rows: List[FinalResult]) -> None:
        """フルリサーチ結果（仕入先/利益情報含む）をスナップショット保存"""
        self.csv_sink.save_full_results(rows)
        if self.db_sink:
            self.db_sink.save_full_results(rows)

# ====================== END OF: app\agents\persistence_agent.py ======================

# ==================== START OF: app\agents\price_intelligence_agent.py ====================
# =================================================================
# File: app/agents/price_intelligence_agent.py
# Registry: app/agents/price_intelligence_agent.py
# "Rev: 9.0 (2025-09-10 09:43 JST)"
#
# 機能概要:
# - BUYMA市場から価格インテリジェンスを収集するプロダクションレベルの専門エージェント。
# - ★戦略★「デュアル抽出戦略」＋「セレクタ一元管理」
#   1. 高機能抽出器（product_info_extractor）を第一選択
#   2. 失敗/不足時はJSフォールバック。セレクタはPython側からJSONで注入
# - ★BOT判定回避強化★人間化動作＋stealth
#
# What's New (v9.0 → v8.1 からの改良点)
#  1. [保守性] セレクタ定義をproduct_info_extractorに一元化。Agent側の二重管理を撤廃。
#  2. [堅牢性] JSフォールバックはPythonからセレクタ定義をJSONで受け取る方式に変更。
#  3. [可読性] 未使用のagentic機能を関連コードごと完全に削除し、意図を明確化。
#  4. [デバッグ性] 抽出戦略の切り替えログを.infoレベルに変更し、通常実行でも確認可能に。
#
# 操作するソフト/前提:
# - Python 3.10+ / Google Chrome / インターネット接続
# - pip install selenium selenium-stealth webdriver-manager beautifulsoup4 lxml
#
# 使い方（単体テスト）:
#   python -m app.agents.price_intelligence_agent "GUCCI" --items 5 --headful

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import time
import logging
import json
import argparse
import random
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Any
from urllib.parse import quote_plus

from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
from selenium.common.exceptions import TimeoutException
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service as ChromeService
from webdriver_manager.chrome import ChromeDriverManager
from selenium_stealth import stealth

# -------------------- 抽出器とセレクタ定義を一元的にインポート --------------------
try:
    # セレクタ定義の唯一の情報源 (Single Source of Truth)
    from app.extractors.product_info_extractor import extract_product_info, SITE_SELS
    EXTRACTOR_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    EXTRACTOR_AVAILABLE = False
    SITE_SELS = {}  # フォールバック用に空の辞書を定義
    logging.error("Fatal: product_info_extractor.pyが見つかりません。エージェントは機能しません。")

# -------------------- ログ設定 --------------------
logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s"
)

# -------------------- エージェント本体 --------------------
class PriceIntelligenceAgent:
    def __init__(self, headless: bool = True, pause_after_search: bool = False):
        self.headless = headless
        self.pause_after_search = pause_after_search
        self.driver: Optional[webdriver.Chrome] = None
        self.wait: Optional[WebDriverWait] = None

        base_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        self.screenshot_dir = base_dir / "instance" / "screenshots"
        self.screenshot_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _init_driver(self):
        if self.driver: return
        options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
        profile_path = Path.home() / "AppData/Local/Google/Chrome/SeleniumProfile"
        options.add_argument(f"--user-data-dir={profile_path}")
        options.add_argument("--profile-directory=Default")
        if self.headless: options.add_argument("--headless=new")
        options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
        options.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
        options.add_argument("--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled")
        options.add_experimental_option("excludeSwitches", ["enable-automation"])
        options.add_experimental_option("useAutomationExtension", False)
        try:
            self.driver = webdriver.Chrome(
                service=ChromeService(ChromeDriverManager().install()), options=options
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Failed to initialize Chrome Driver: {e}")
            raise
        stealth(self.driver,
                languages=["ja-JP", "ja"],
                vendor="Google Inc.",
                platform="Win32",
                webgl_vendor="Intel Inc.",
                renderer="Intel Iris OpenGL Engine",
                fix_hairline=True)
        self.wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 20)

    def _quit_driver(self):
        if self.driver:
            try:
                self.driver.quit()
            except Exception as e:
                logging.error(f"Error quitting driver: {e}")
            finally:
                self.driver = None

    def _save_failure_screenshot(self, context_name: str) -> None:
        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        fp = self.screenshot_dir / f"failure_{context_name}_{ts}.png"
        try:
            self.driver.save_screenshot(str(fp))
            logging.error(f"Saved failure screenshot to: {fp}")
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Failed to save screenshot: {e}")

    def _wait_for_results_page(self) -> bool:
        try:
            WebDriverWait(self.driver, 15).until(
                lambda d: len(d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "a[href*='/item/']")) > 0
            )
            logging.info("Search results page confirmed by product links.")
            return True
        except TimeoutException:
            logging.warning("Primary condition timed out. Trying secondary container...")
            try:
                WebDriverWait(self.driver, 8).until(
                    EC.presence_of_element_located((By.ID, "search_result_box"))
                )
                logging.info("Search results page confirmed by container box.")
                return True
            except TimeoutException:
                logging.error("Failed to confirm results page load by any method.")
                return False

    def _perform_human_like_search(self, brand_name: str) -> bool:
        def _find_search_input():
            candidates = [
                (By.ID, "header_search_kw"),
                (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[name='q']"),
                (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input#kw"),
                (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "form[action*='/r/'] input[type='text']"),
                (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[placeholder*='ブランド名'][placeholder*='キーワード']"),
            ]
            for by, sel in candidates:
                try:
                    el = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 15).until(EC.presence_of_element_located((by, sel)))
                    if el and el.is_enabled():
                        return el
                except Exception:
                    continue
            return None

        try:
            logging.info("Navigating to BUYMA top page...")
            self.driver.get("https://www.buyma.com/")
            WebDriverWait(self.driver, 20).until(lambda d: d.execute_script("return document.readyState") == "complete")
            try:
                btn = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 5).until(
                    EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.ID, "onetrust-accept-btn-handler"))
                )
                btn.click()
                logging.info("Cookie banner accepted.")
            except TimeoutException:
                pass

            for attempt in range(2):
                logging.info(f"Performing human-like search for '{brand_name}' (attempt {attempt+1}/2)...")
                sb = _find_search_input()
                if not sb:
                    logging.warning("Search input not found on this attempt.")
                    continue
                try: sb.clear()
                except Exception: pass
                for ch in brand_name:
                    sb.send_keys(ch)
                    time.sleep(random.uniform(0.05, 0.15))

                sb.send_keys(Keys.RETURN)

                try:
                    if self._wait_for_results_page():
                        logging.info("Search results loaded after human-like interaction.")
                        return True
                    else:
                        logging.warning("Could not confirm results after human-like interaction; retrying...")
                except Exception as e_wait:
                    logging.warning(f"An error occurred while waiting for results page: {e_wait}. Retrying...")

            logging.warning("Falling back to direct search URL...")
            self.driver.get(f"https://www.buyma.com/r/?kw={quote_plus(brand_name)}")
            if self._wait_for_results_page():
                logging.info("Direct URL search results page loaded successfully.")
                return True
            else:
                logging.error("Direct URL search also failed.")
                self._save_failure_screenshot(f"buyma_search_failed_{brand_name}")
                return False
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Unexpected error during search: {e}")
            self._save_failure_screenshot(f"buyma_search_error_{brand_name}")
            return False

    def _js_collect_item_anchors(self):
        script = """
        const out = [];
        const anchors = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("a[href*='/item/']"));
        const yenRe = /[¥\\u00A5]\\s*([\\d,]+)|([\\d,]+)\\s*円/;
        const saleRe = /タイムセール|%OFF|限定価格/;
        function text(e){ return (e && (e.innerText || e.textContent) || "").replace(/\\s+/g," ").trim(); }
        for (const a of anchors){
          try{
            let root = a.closest("li, article, div[class*='product'], div[class*='card']") || a.parentElement;
            const href = a.getAttribute('href');
            const url = href && href.startsWith('http') ? href : (location.origin + (href || ""));
            const nameAttr = a.getAttribute('aria-label') || a.getAttribute('title') || '';
            const rawName = nameAttr || text(a) || text(root).slice(0,250);
            const name = rawName.replace(/(商品情報を編集|お気に入り|カートに入れる|送料込|税込|％OFF|クーポン|\\d+円\\s*OFF|タイムセール)/g, '').trim();
            const cardText = text(root);
            const m = cardText.match(yenRe);
            out.push({
              url, name,
              buyma_price: m ? parseInt((m[1] || m[2]).replace(/,/g,'')) : null,
              sale_flag_in_list: saleRe.test(cardText)
            });
          }catch(e){}
        }
        return out;
        """
        return self.driver.execute_script(script)

    def _extract_price_intelligence_from_pdp(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        html = self.driver.page_source
        if EXTRACTOR_AVAILABLE:
            try:
                data = extract_product_info(html, site="BUYMA")
                if data.get("price"):
                    logging.info("PDP extracted via product_info_extractor (Python)")
                    return data
            except Exception as e:
                logging.warning(f"extract_product_info failed: {e} -> fallback to JS")

        logging.info("Falling back to PDP extraction via JS v2025")
        site_config = SITE_SELS.get("BUYMA", {})
        return self._extract_pdp_js_v2025(site_config)

    def _extract_pdp_js_v2025(self, site_config: Dict) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # Pythonの辞書をJSON文字列に変換してJSに渡す
        config_json = json.dumps(site_config)

        script = f"""
        const sels = {config_json};
        const out = {{ price:null, list_price:null, discount_pct:null, sale_until:null, title:'' }};
        const toInt = s=> s? parseInt(String(s).replace(/[^\\d]/g,'')) : null;

        const YEN_RE = /[¥\\u00A5]\\s*([\\d,]+)|([\\d,]+)\\s*円/;
        const PCT_RE = /(\\d{{1,3}})\\s*[%％]\\s*OFF|OFF\\s*(\\d{{1,3}})\\s*[%％]|割引.*?(\\d{{1,3}})\\s*[%％]|SALE.*?(\\d{{1,3}})\\s*[%％]/i;

        const sel_map = {{
            title: 'title',
            price: 'price',
            list_price: 'list_price',
            discount: 'discount_pct',
            sale_until: 'sale_until'
        }};

        for(const key in sel_map){{
          if(!sels[key]) continue;
          for(const sel of sels[key]){{
            const el = document.querySelector(sel);
            if(!el) continue;
            const txt = (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").trim();
            const out_key = sel_map[key];

            if(key==='title') {{ out.title = txt; break; }}
            if(key==='price' || key==='list_price') {{
              const m = txt.match(YEN_RE);
              const val = m ? toInt(m[0]) : null;
              if(val){{ out[out_key] = val; break; }}
            }} else if(key==='discount'){{
              const m = txt.match(PCT_RE);
              if(m){{
                const pct = parseInt(m[1]||m[2]||m[3]||m[4]);
                if(!isNaN(pct)){{ out.discount_pct = pct; break; }}
              }}
            }}
          }}
        }}

        try{{
          const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("script[type='application/ld+json']"));
          for(const sc of scripts){{
            const node = JSON.parse(sc.textContent);
            const walk = (n)=>{{
              if(Array.isArray(n)) n.forEach(walk);
              else if(typeof n==='object' && n){{
                if(n['@type']==='Product'){{
                  if(n.name && !out.title) out.title = n.name;
                  const o = Array.isArray(n.offers)? n.offers[0] : n.offers;
                  if(o){{
                    if(o.price && !out.price) out.price = toInt(o.price);
                    if(o.priceValidUntil && !out.sale_until) out.sale_until = o.priceValidUntil;
                    const ps = o.priceSpecification;
                    if(ps && ps.price && !out.list_price) out.list_price = toInt(ps.price);
                  }}
                }}
                Object.values(n).forEach(v=> (typeof v==='object')&&walk(v));
              }}
            }};
            walk(node);
          }}
        }}catch(e){{}}
        if(out.price && out.list_price && !out.discount_pct && out.list_price>out.price){{
          out.discount_pct = Math.round((out.list_price - out.price)*100/out.list_price);
        }}
        if(out.price && out.discount_pct && !out.list_price && out.discount_pct>0 && out.discount_pct<100){{
          out.list_price = Math.round(out.price / (1 - out.discount_pct/100));
        }}
        return out;
        """
        try:
            return self.driver.execute_script(script)
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"JS v2025 extraction failed: {e}")
            return {{}}

    def _scrape_buyma(self, brand_name: str, item_limit: int = 5) -> List[Dict]:
        logging.info(f"[PriceIntelAgent] Researching BUYMA for brand: {brand_name}")
        if not self._perform_human_like_search(brand_name):
            logging.error("All attempts to reach the search results page have failed.")
            return []

        if not self.headless and self.pause_after_search:
            try:
                print("\n" + "=" * 50 + "\n[PriceIntelAgent] Search complete. Pausing... Press Enter to scrape.\n" + "=" * 50 + "\n")
                input()
            except Exception as e:
                logging.warning(f"Could not wait for user input: {e}")

        try: self.driver.set_window_size(1400, 1200)
        except Exception: pass

        anchors, seen = [], set()
        for i in range(6):
            logging.info(f"Scrolling page... ({i + 1}/6)")
            try: self.driver.execute_script("window.scrollBy(0, Math.max(900, window.innerHeight * 0.9));")
            except Exception as e: logging.warning(f"Scrolling failed: {e}")
            time.sleep(random.uniform(0.8, 1.2))

            try: batch = self._js_collect_item_anchors()
            except Exception as e:
                logging.warning(f"JS anchor collection failed: {e}")
                batch = []

            new_items = 0
            for it in batch:
                if "/item/" not in (url := it.get("url", "")) or url in seen: continue
                seen.add(url)
                anchors.append(it)
                new_items += 1

            if len(anchors) >= item_limit:
                logging.info(f"Target item count ({item_limit}) reached.")
                break
            if new_items == 0 and i > 1:
                logging.info("No new items found on scroll, ending collection.")
                break

        if not anchors:
            self._save_failure_screenshot(f"buyma_no_products_{brand_name}")
            logging.error("No product anchors found on the results page.")
            return []

        logging.info(f"Found {len(anchors)} items. Extracting PDP intelligence for the first {item_limit} items...")
        results: List[Dict] = []
        for card in anchors[:item_limit]:
            pdp_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
            for attempt in range(2):
                try:
                    self.driver.get(card["url"])
                    time.sleep(random.uniform(1.4, 2.4))
                    pdp_data = self._extract_price_intelligence_from_pdp()
                    if pdp_data and pdp_data.get("price"):
                        break
                except Exception as e:
                    logging.warning(f"Attempt {attempt + 1}/2 failed for PDP {card['url']}: {e}")
                if attempt == 1:
                    self._save_failure_screenshot(f"pdp_extract_failed_{brand_name}")

            if pdp_data and pdp_data.get("price"):
                results.append({
                    "name": pdp_data.get("title") or card.get("name"),
                    "buyma_url": card["url"],
                    "buyma_price": pdp_data.get("price"),
                    "buyma_list_price": pdp_data.get("list_price"),
                    "buyma_discount_pct": pdp_data.get("discount_pct"),
                    "buyma_sale_until": pdp_data.get("sale_until"),
                    "captured_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                    "brand": brand_name,
                })
            elif card.get("buyma_price"):
                logging.warning(f"Using fallback price from list for {card['url']}")
                results.append({
                    "name": card.get("name"),
                    "buyma_url": card["url"],
                    "buyma_price": card.get("buyma_price"),
                    "buyma_list_price": None, "buyma_discount_pct": None,
                    "captured_at": datetime.now().isoformat(), "brand": brand_name,
                })

        logging.info(f"Intelligence extracted for {len(results)} products from BUYMA.")
        return results

    def run(self, brand_name: str, target_site: str = "BUYMA", item_limit: int = 5) -> List[Dict]:
        if not EXTRACTOR_AVAILABLE:
            logging.critical("Extractor module is missing. Aborting operation.")
            return []
        try:
            self._init_driver()
            if target_site.upper() == "BUYMA":
                return self._scrape_buyma(brand_name, item_limit)
            else:
                logging.error(f"Target site '{target_site}' is not supported by this agent.")
                return []
        except Exception as e:
            logging.exception(f"A critical error occurred in PriceIntelligenceAgent: {e}")
            return []
        finally:
            self._quit_driver()
            logging.info(f"[PriceIntelAgent] {target_site} research session complete.")

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Price Intelligence Agent for Market Research",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawTextHelpFormatter
    )
    parser.add_argument("brand", help="The brand name to research (e.g., GUCCI)")
    parser.add_argument("--items", type=int, default=3, help="Number of items to process (default: 3)")
    parser.add_argument("--headful", action="store_true", help="Run browser in headful mode (non-headless).")
    parser.add_argument("--site", default="BUYMA", help="Target site (currently only 'BUYMA' is supported).")
    parser.add_argument("--pause-after-search", action="store_true", help="Pause for manual check after reaching search results.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    agent = PriceIntelligenceAgent(
        headless=not args.headful,
        pause_after_search=args.pause_after_search
    )
    results = agent.run(brand_name=args.brand, target_site=args.site, item_limit=args.items)
    print("\n--- Price Intelligence Agent Results ---")
    print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


# ====================== END OF: app\agents\price_intelligence_agent.py ======================

# ==================== START OF: app\agents\profitability_agent.py ====================
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
profitability_agent.py (堅牢性・再利用性向上版)
======================================================================
Registry: app/agents/profitability_agent.py
Rev: 2.0 (2025-09-08 JST)

機能概要:
- 利益計算の責務を担う、高度化された専門エージェント。
- ★戦略更新★「堅牢性の強化」:
  - Pydanticによる厳格な入出力スキーマ検証を導入し、データの不整合を早期に検知。
  - 為替レート取得失敗時に安全なフォールバック値を使用し、システムの停止を防止。
  - LLMによる要約生成失敗時も、ルールベースの簡易サマリーを返すことで応答性を維持。
- ★戦略更新★「抽象化による拡張性の向上」:
  - 関税率の決定ロジックを専用メソッドに分離し、将来的なルール変更に容易に対応可能。
- 既存の連携機能（ShippingAgent, LLMController）はすべて維持・強化。

--- 操作するソフト/前提 ---
- Python 3.10以上
- `pip install pydantic`
- OpenAI APIキー (LLMによるサマリー生成に必要)
======================================================================
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional

# Pydanticによる厳格なデータモデル定義
try:
    from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ValidationError
except ImportError:
    print("Pydantic is not installed. Please run 'pip install pydantic'.")
    # Pydanticがない場合は、ダミーのBaseModelで最低限動作させる
    BaseModel = object
    Field = lambda **kwargs: None
    ValidationError = Exception

# --- 既存の専門エージェントとユーティリティをインポート ---
try:
    from app.utils.ai_llm_controller import AILlmController
    LLM_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    logging.warning("AILlmController not found. LLM-based summary will be disabled.")
    AILlmController = None
    LLM_AVAILABLE = False

try:
    from app.utils.shipping_agent import ShippingAgent
    SHIPPING_AGENT_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    logging.warning("ShippingAgent not found. Using fixed shipping costs.")
    ShippingAgent = None
    SHIPPING_AGENT_AVAILABLE = False

try:
    from app.utils.fx_utils import get_fx_table_jpy
except ImportError:
     logging.warning("fx_utils not found. Using dummy exchange rates.")
     def get_fx_table_jpy(**kwargs) -> tuple[dict, dict]: return {"USD": 150.0}, {}

# --- Pydanticによる入出力スキーマ定義 ---

class MarketData(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = None
    buyma_price: float = Field(gt=0)

class SupplierData(BaseModel):
    price: float = Field(gt=0)
    currency: str
    category: Optional[str] = None
    material: Optional[str] = None

class Assessment(BaseModel):
    decision: str
    summary: str
    profit_estimate: int
    profit_rate: float
    total_cost_jpy: int
    exchange_rate_used: float
    source_currency: str

class ProfitabilityAgent:
    """商品の収益性を多角的に分析・評価する専門エージェント。"""

    def __init__(self, headless_shipping: bool = True):
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
        if LLM_AVAILABLE:
            self.llm_controller = AILlmController()
        if SHIPPING_AGENT_AVAILABLE:
            self.shipping_agent = ShippingAgent(headless=headless_shipping)

    def _get_exchange_rate_jpy(self, currency: str) -> float:
        """為替レートを取得し、失敗時にはフォールバック値を返す。"""
        try:
            fx_table, _ = get_fx_table_jpy(auto=True, ttl_hours=6)
            rate = fx_table.get(currency.upper())
            if not rate:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported currency: {currency}")
            self.logger.info(f"Fetched exchange rate for {currency}: {rate}")
            return float(rate)
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"FX fetch/lookup failed for {currency} ({e}); using fallback 150.0")
            return 150.0

    def _resolve_customs_rate(self, category: Optional[str], material: Optional[str]) -> float:
        """商品情報に基づき、関税率を決定する（将来拡張用）。"""
        # 例: 革製品や特定のカテゴリは関税率を高めに設定
        if material and any(m in material for m in ["レザー", "革"]):
            return 0.12 # 革製品: 12%
        if category and any(c in category for c in ["バッグ", "シューズ"]):
            return 0.11 # バッグ・靴: 11%
        return 0.10 # デフォルト: 10%

    def _get_dynamic_shipping_cost(self, source_currency: str) -> float:
        """ShippingAgentと連携し、動的な送料を取得する。"""
        if not SHIPPING_AGENT_AVAILABLE:
            self.logger.info("Using fixed shipping cost: 30 USD")
            return 30.0 if source_currency.upper() == "USD" else 4500.0
        try:
            self.logger.info("Dynamically fetching shipping info (using fixed cost for now).")
            return 30.0 # 仮にUSDで30ドルとする
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Failed to get dynamic shipping cost: {e}. Falling back to fixed cost.")
            return 30.0

    def _calculate_core_profit(self, market: MarketData, supplier: SupplierData) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """中核となる利益計算ロジック。"""
        exchange_rate = self._get_exchange_rate_jpy(supplier.currency)
        shipping_cost = self._get_dynamic_shipping_cost(supplier.currency)
        customs_rate = self._resolve_customs_rate(supplier.category, supplier.material)

        source_price_jpy = supplier.price * exchange_rate
        shipping_cost_jpy = shipping_cost * exchange_rate

        cost_before_customs = source_price_jpy + shipping_cost_jpy
        customs_duty = cost_before_customs * customs_rate
        total_cost_jpy = cost_before_customs + customs_duty

        buyma_commission = market.buyma_price * 0.077

        net_revenue = market.buyma_price - buyma_commission
        profit_estimate = net_revenue - total_cost_jpy
        profit_rate = (profit_estimate / market.buyma_price) * 100 if market.buyma_price > 0 else 0

        return {
            "profit_estimate": int(round(profit_estimate)),
            "profit_rate": round(profit_rate, 2),
            "total_cost_jpy": int(round(total_cost_jpy)),
            "exchange_rate_used": exchange_rate,
            "source_currency": supplier.currency.upper(),
        }

    def _generate_assessment_summary(self, calc_result: Dict[str, Any], model_name: str = 'gemini') -> str:
        """LLMを使って、計算結果から定性的な評価サマリーを生成する。"""
        profit = calc_result.get('profit_estimate', 0)

        # ルールベースの簡易判定
        if profit < 1500:
            return "推奨しません。推定利益が基準値（1500円）を下回っています。"

        # LLMが利用できない、または失敗した場合のフォールバック
        if not LLM_AVAILABLE:
            return f"推奨します。推定利益: {profit}円 ({calc_result.get('profit_rate')}%)"

        prompt = f"""
あなたはプロのEコマースアナリストです。以下の収益性評価データに基づき、この商品を買い付けるべきかどうかの最終判断を、簡潔な日本語で要約してください。
# 収益性データ
- 推定利益: {profit} 円
- 利益率: {calc_result.get('profit_rate')}%
- 総原価 (関税・送料込): {calc_result.get('total_cost_jpy')} 円
- 適用為替レート: 1 {calc_result.get('source_currency')} = {calc_result.get('exchange_rate_used')} JPY
# 指示
- 結論（「推奨」「非推奨」など）を最初に述べてください。ポジティブな点と、潜在的なリスク（例: 為替変動）を指摘してください。全体で100文字程度でまとめてください。
"""
        try:
            return self.llm_controller.generate(prompt, model_name=model_name)
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"LLM summary generation failed: {e}")
            # LLM失敗時のフォールバックサマリー
            return f"推奨します。推定利益: {profit}円 ({calc_result.get('profit_rate')}%)。AIによる詳細分析中にエラーが発生しました。"

    def assess(self, market_data: Dict, supplier_data: Dict, llm_model: str = 'gemini') -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        市場データと仕入先データを基に、商品の収益性を総合的に評価する。
        """
        self.logger.info(f"Assessing profitability for: {market_data.get('name', 'N/A')}")

        # 1. Pydanticによる入力データの検証
        try:
            market = MarketData(**market_data)
            supplier = SupplierData(**supplier_data)
        except ValidationError as ve:
            summary = f"入力データの検証に失敗しました: {ve.errors()}"
            self.logger.error(summary)
            return {"decision": "error", "summary": summary}
        except Exception as e:
             return {"decision": "error", "summary": f"予期せぬ入力エラー: {e}"}

        # 2. 中核となる利益計算を実行
        calculation = self._calculate_core_profit(market, supplier)

        # 3. LLMによる評価サマリーを生成
        summary = self._generate_assessment_summary(calculation, model_name=llm_model)

        # 4. Pydanticモデルで出力データを整形・保証
        assessment_data = {
            "decision": "profitable" if calculation.get('profit_estimate', 0) > 1500 else "not_profitable",
            "summary": summary,
            **calculation
        }

        try:
            return Assessment(**assessment_data).model_dump()
        except ValidationError:
            # 万が一、内部の計算結果が出力スキーマに違反した場合のエラーハンドリング
            self.logger.error("Internal calculation resulted in invalid assessment data.")
            assessment_data['summary'] = "内部エラー: 評価データの生成に失敗しました。"
            assessment_data['decision'] = "error"
            return assessment_data

# ====================== END OF: app\agents\profitability_agent.py ======================

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import logging

# --- PDF Tool (optional) ---

# --- DB (optional) ---

# =============================================================================
# ユーティリティ: EMA とフォーマット
# =============================================================================
def ema(values: Sequence[float], period: int) -> Optional[float]:
    """EMA: alpha = 2/(period+1); EMA[t] = alpha*v + (1-alpha)*EMA[t-1]"""
    if not values: return None
    alpha = 2 / (period + 1)
    e = float(values[0])
    for v in values[1:]:
        e = alpha * float(v) + (1 - alpha) * e
    return round(e, 2)

def pct_change(old: Optional[float], new: Optional[float]) -> Optional[float]:
    if old is None or new is None or old == 0: return None
    return round((new - old) * 100.0 / old, 2)

def fmt_yen(n: Optional[float]) -> str:
    if n is None: return "-"
    return f"¥{int(round(n)):,}"

def today_str() -> str:
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# =============================================================================
# データアクセサ: CSV / DB
# =============================================================================
@dataclass
class HistoryRow:
    captured_at: datetime
    brand: str
    name: str
    url: str
    price: Optional[float]
    list_price: Optional[float]
    discount_pct: Optional[float]
    sale_until: Optional[datetime]

class DataSource:
    def __init__(self, use_db: bool = False, input_dir: Path = Path("output")) -> None:
        self.use_db = use_db and FLASK_AVAILABLE and ProductPriceHistory is not None
        self.input_dir = input_dir
        if self.use_db:
            logging.info("[DataSource] Using DB (ProductPriceHistory).")
        else:
            logging.info(f"[DataSource] Using CSV files from '{self.input_dir}'.")

    def _parse_csv_history_files(self, brand: str, days: int) -> List[HistoryRow]:
        cutoff = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=days)
        rows: List[HistoryRow] = []

        candidates = [
            f"price_history_{brand}_*.csv",
            f"price_history_{brand.replace(' ', '_')}_*.csv",
            f"price_history_{brand.upper()}_*.csv",
            f"price_history_{brand.title()}_*.csv",
            "price_history_*_*.csv",
        ]
        seen = set()
        files_to_process: List[Path] = []
        for pat in candidates:
            for fp in self.input_dir.glob(pat):
                if fp not in seen:
                    seen.add(fp)
                    files_to_process.append(fp)

        for fp in sorted(files_to_process):
            try:
                with fp.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
                    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
                    for rec in reader:
                        ts = rec.get("captured_at") or ""
                        try: dt = datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
                        except Exception: continue
                        if dt < cutoff: continue

                        rec_brand = (rec.get("brand") or "").strip()
                        if rec_brand and rec_brand.lower() != brand.lower():
                            continue

                        rows.append(
                            HistoryRow(
                                captured_at=dt,
                                brand=rec_brand or brand,
                                name=rec.get("name") or "",
                                url=rec.get("buyma_url") or "",
                                price=float(rec["buyma_price"]) if rec.get("buyma_price") else None,
                                list_price=float(rec["buyma_list_price"]) if rec.get("buyma_list_price") else None,
                                discount_pct=float(rec["buyma_discount_pct"]) if rec.get("buyma_discount_pct") else None,
                                sale_until=datetime.fromisoformat(rec["buyma_sale_until"]) if rec.get("buyma_sale_until") else None,
                            )
                        )
            except Exception as e:
                logging.warning(f"[Reporting] Skip CSV {fp}: {e}")
        return rows

    def fetch_history(self, brand: str, days: int = 30) -> List[HistoryRow]:
        if self.use_db:
            cutoff = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=days)
            q = (
                ProductPriceHistory.query.filter(ProductPriceHistory.brand == brand)
                .filter(ProductPriceHistory.captured_at >= cutoff)
                .order_by(ProductPriceHistory.url.asc(), ProductPriceHistory.captured_at.asc())
            )
            return [
                HistoryRow(
                    captured_at=r.captured_at, brand=r.brand or brand, name=r.name or "",
                    url=r.url or "", price=float(r.price) if r.price is not None else None,
                    list_price=float(r.list_price) if r.list_price is not None else None,
                    discount_pct=float(r.discount_pct) if r.discount_pct is not None else None,
                    sale_until=r.sale_until if getattr(r, "sale_until", None) else None,
                ) for r in q.all()
            ]
        else:
            return self._parse_csv_history_files(brand, days)

# =============================================================================
# 集計ロジック
# =============================================================================
@dataclass
class SeriesPoint:
    dt: datetime
    price: Optional[float]
    list_price: Optional[float]
    discount_pct: Optional[float]
    sale_until: Optional[datetime]

@dataclass
class UrlSeries:
    url: str
    name: str
    points: List[SeriesPoint]

@dataclass
class ProfitCandidate:
    url: str
    name: str
    profit: float
    profit_rate: float
    asof: datetime

class ReportingAgent:
    def __init__(self, use_db: bool = False, input_dir: Path = Path("output")) -> None:
        self.ds = DataSource(use_db=use_db, input_dir=input_dir)
        self.output_dir = Path("output/reports")
        self.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _build_url_series(self, rows: List[HistoryRow]) -> List[UrlSeries]:
        bucket: Dict[str, List[HistoryRow]] = {}
        for r in rows:
            bucket.setdefault(r.url, []).append(r)

        # v1.4: PEP 572 違反の walrus operator を修正
        # 内包表記からプレーンな for ループにリファクタリング
        url_series_list: List[UrlSeries] = []
        for url, items in bucket.items():
            # 先にソート済みリストを変数に代入
            items_sorted = sorted(items, key=lambda x: x.captured_at)

            # ソート済みリストを使ってポイントを作成
            points = [
                SeriesPoint(
                    dt=it.captured_at, price=it.price, list_price=it.list_price,
                    discount_pct=it.discount_pct, sale_until=it.sale_until
                )
                for it in items_sorted
            ]

            url_series_list.append(
                UrlSeries(
                    url=url,
                    name=(items_sorted[-1].name if items_sorted else ""),
                    points=points,
                )
            )
        return url_series_list

    def _compute_ema_snapshot(self, series: UrlSeries, window_days: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        cutoff = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=window_days)
        vals = [p.price for p in series.points if p.dt >= cutoff and p.price is not None]
        if not vals: return {"ema7": None, "ema28": None, "latest": None}
        return {"ema7": ema(vals, 7), "ema28": ema(vals, 28), "latest": vals[-1]}

    def _detect_alerts_for_today(self, series: UrlSeries) -> List[str]:
        msgs: List[str] = []
        today, yesterday = datetime.now().date(), (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=1)).date()

        todays_pts = [p for p in series.points if p.dt.date() == today]
        yest_pts = [p for p in series.points if p.dt.date() == yesterday]

        if not todays_pts:
            return []

        latest_point = todays_pts[-1]

        # 1. 価格急変アラート
        if yest_pts and latest_point.price is not None and yest_pts[-1].price is not None:
            price_ch = pct_change(yest_pts[-1].price, latest_point.price)
            if price_ch is not None and abs(price_ch) >= 10.0:
                msgs.append(f"価格急変: {price_ch:+}%")

        # 2. 割引率急変アラート
        if yest_pts and latest_point.discount_pct is not None and yest_pts[-1].discount_pct is not None:
            discount_ch = pct_change(yest_pts[-1].discount_pct, latest_point.discount_pct)
            if (discount_ch is not None and abs(discount_ch) >= 15.0) or \
               (yest_pts[-1].discount_pct == 0 and latest_point.discount_pct > 0):
                msgs.append(f"割引率変動: {latest_point.discount_pct}%")

        # 3. セール期限アラート
        if latest_point.sale_until:
            days_left = (latest_point.sale_until.date() - today).days
            if 0 <= days_left <= 3:
                msgs.append(f"セール終了まであと{days_left}日")

        return msgs

    def _collect_profit_candidates(self, brand: str, top_n: int = 10) -> List[ProfitCandidate]:
        cand: List[ProfitCandidate] = []
        patterns = [
            f"research_{brand}_*.json", f"research_{brand.replace(' ', '_')}_*.json",
            f"research_{brand.upper()}_*.json", f"research_{brand.title()}_*.json",
            "research_*_*.json",
        ]
        files = []
        seen = set()
        for pat in patterns:
            for fp in Path("output").glob(pat):
                if fp not in seen:
                    seen.add(fp); files.append(fp)

        for fp in sorted(files, reverse=True):
            try:
                m = re.search(r"_(\d{8}_\d{6})$", fp.stem)
                if not m: continue
                ts, dt = m.group(1), datetime.strptime(m.group(1), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
                if dt.date() != datetime.now().date(): continue

                data = json.loads(fp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                for row in data:
                    rb = (row.get("brand") or "").strip()
                    if rb and rb.lower() != brand.lower(): continue

                    if (pr := float(row.get("profit") or 0)) > 1500:
                        cand.append(
                            ProfitCandidate(
                                url=row.get("supplier_url") or row.get("buyma_url") or "", name=row.get("name") or "",
                                profit=pr, profit_rate=float(row.get("profit_rate") or 0), asof=dt,
                            )
                        )
            except Exception: continue

        cand.sort(key=lambda x: (x.profit, x.profit_rate), reverse=True)
        return cand[:top_n]

    def _render_html(self, brand: str, url_series: List[UrlSeries], profit_top: List[ProfitCandidate]) -> str:
        today = today_str()
        rows_7, rows_28, alerts_html = [], [], []

        for s in url_series:
            snap7, snap28 = self._compute_ema_snapshot(s, 7), self._compute_ema_snapshot(s, 28)
            rows_7.append(f"<tr><td><a href='{s.url}'>{s.name[:80]}</a></td><td>{fmt_yen(snap7['latest'])}</td><td>{fmt_yen(snap7['ema7'])}</td><td>{fmt_yen(snap7['ema28'])}</td></tr>")
            rows_28.append(f"<tr><td><a href='{s.url}'>{s.name[:80]}</a></td><td>{fmt_yen(snap28['latest'])}</td><td>{fmt_yen(snap28['ema7'])}</td><td>{fmt_yen(snap28['ema28'])}</td></tr>")
            if alerts := self._detect_alerts_for_today(s):
                alerts_html.append(f"<li><a href='{s.url}'>{s.name[:80]}</a>: {' / '.join(alerts)}</li>")

        for c in profit_top:
            profit_alert_msg = f"高利益アラート: {fmt_yen(c.profit)} ({c.profit_rate}%)"
            alerts_html.append(f"<li><a href='{c.url}'>{c.name[:80]}</a>: {profit_alert_msg}</li>")

        profit_rows = [
            f"<tr><td><a href='{c.url}'>{c.name[:80]}</a></td><td>{fmt_yen(c.profit)}</td><td>{c.profit_rate}%</td><td>{c.asof.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}</td></tr>"
            for c in profit_top
        ]

        html = f"""
<!doctype html><html lang="ja"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Daily Report - {brand} - {today}</title>
<style>body{{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif;margin:24px;color:#222}}h1,h2{{margin:24px 0 8px}}h1{{font-size:20px}}h2{{font-size:16px}}table{{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:13px}}th,td{{border:1px solid #ddd;padding:6px 8px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}}th{{background:#f6f6f6}}td a{{color:#005bb1;text-decoration:none}}td a:hover{{text-decoration:underline}}td:first-child{{white-space:normal;min-width:300px}}.small{{color:#666;font-size:12px}}.alerts li{{margin:4px 0}}</style>
</head><body><h1>Daily Report <span class="small">({brand})</span></h1><div class="small">{today}</div>
<h2>今日のアラート</h2><ul class="alerts">{''.join(alerts_html) if alerts_html else '<li>該当なし</li>'}</ul>
<h2>直近7日のスナップショット（最新価格 / EMA7 / EMA28）</h2><table><thead><tr><th>商品</th><th>最新</th><th>EMA7</th><th>EMA28</th></tr></thead><tbody>{''.join(rows_7)}</tbody></table>
<h2>直近28日のスナップショット（最新価格 / EMA7 / EMA28）</h2><table><thead><tr><th>商品</th><th>最新</th><th>EMA7</th><th>EMA28</th></tr></thead><tbody>{''.join(rows_28)}</tbody></table>
<h2>利益候補 Top</h2><table><thead><tr><th>商品</th><th>推定利益</th><th>利益率</th><th>検出時刻</th></tr></thead><tbody>{''.join(profit_rows) if profit_rows else '<tr><td colspan="4">該当なし</td></tr>'}</tbody></table>
</body></html>"""
        return html.strip()

    def build_daily_report(self, brand: str, days: int = 30, top_n: int = 10) -> Path:
        rows = self.ds.fetch_history(brand=brand, days=days)
        if not rows:
            logging.warning(f"[Reporting] no history rows for brand='{brand}' days={days}")

        url_series = self._build_url_series(rows)
        profit_top = self._collect_profit_candidates(brand=brand, top_n=top_n)
        html = self._render_html(brand, url_series, profit_top)

        ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d")
        out_path = self.output_dir / f"daily_report_{brand}_{ts}.html"
        out_path.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")

        logging.info(f"[Reporting] HTML report saved successfully: {out_path}")
        return out_path

# =============================================================================
# CLI
# =============================================================================
if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="ReportingAgent: build daily brand report (HTML; PDF optional via WeasyPrint/wkhtmltopdf)")
    parser.add_argument("brand", help="Brand name to generate a report for.")
    parser.add_argument("--days", type=int, default=30, help="Number of days of history to include.")
    parser.add_argument("--top-n", type=int, default=10, help="Number of top profit candidates to list.")
    parser.add_argument("--db", action="store_true", help="Use DB as the data source instead of CSV files.")
    parser.add_argument("--pdf", action="store_true", help="Also export PDF using WeasyPrint or wkhtmltopdf")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    agent = ReportingAgent(use_db=args.db)
    out_html = agent.build_daily_report(brand=args.brand, days=args.days, top_n=args.top_n)

    if args.pdf:
        try:
            pdf_out = convert_html_file_to_pdf(out_html)
            logging.info(f"[Reporting] PDF also saved: {pdf_out}")
        except Exception as e:
            logging.warning(f"[Reporting] PDF export failed: {e}")

    print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "output_html": str(out_html)}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

# =================================================================

# Registry: app/extractors/product_info_extractor.py
# Date & Time (JST): 2025-09-10 03:25:00
# Version: 3.8J ※日本語パーセント（％）も確実に拾う最終完全版

# What's New (v3.8J ← v3.7J)

#  3. その他すべての機能は v3.7J 準拠（価格・定価・タイトル・sale_until など）
#
# 動作環境 / 必要ソフト
#  - Python 3.10 以上（標準ライブラリのみ）
#  - beautifulsoup4, lxml (pip install beautifulsoup4 lxml)

#
# 最小動作例
#  -----------------------------------------------------------------
